description: Single Jetson Orin Nano 8GB (Super mode)-inspired endpoint; one serialized compute resource, no inter-device traffic, fixed compute times.

reference_specs.variant: Jetson Orin Nano 8GB with Super-mode reference specifications, not the 4GB variant or Orin Nano 2

assumptions: One rank represents one Jetson with one serialized, non-preemptive compute resource. This does not imply that the physical Jetson has only one CPU core or GPU execution unit.
The reference memory and compute values follow NVIDIA's Super-mode specifications, not the original lower-clock 15W configuration; actual clocks depend on JetPack, power mode, and thermals.
The singleton FullyConnected topology has no inter-device traffic. Its positive bandwidth is an unused parser placeholder, not a modeled Ethernet connection or LPDDR5 bus.
The 10-cycle endpoint delay is a synthetic inherited setting, not a measured Jetson timing; the single-processor workload has no communication events.

local-mem-bw=102 GB/s and peak-perf=2.1 FP32 TFLOPS are reference values only; roofline is disabled and trace durations determine compute time. Sparse INT8 TOPS are not used as floating-point throughput.

The 8GB shared CPU/GPU memory capacity is descriptive metadata, not a capacity constraint; unified-memory contention, caches, memory controllers, Tensor Core kernels, DVFS, power, and thermals are not simulated.

The single-processor demo uses independent tasks arriving at time zero, known synthetic durations, and zero scheduling/context-switch overhead. Its mean completion and waiting times are analytical values derived from the selected order, not ASTRA per-event timestamps or Jetson measurements.
NO_MEMORY_EXPANSION disables remote memory expansion; it does not remove local LPDDR5 memory.
